Thesis

Districts are consolidating point solutions. Our wedge is the operational spine — absence, sub fill, and SPED compliance — where switching costs are highest and data gravity already favors us.

Three bets

  1. Unify identity across HCM and Student modules so a district admin sees one roster of record.
  2. Ship analytics that answer board-meeting questions, not dashboards that require an analyst.
  3. Make compliance reporting a byproduct of daily work rather than a quarterly scramble.

Open

Pricing model for the unified tier is unresolved. Finance wants seat-based; the field wants per-student.
